SUPERVISOR RULING 3(c): confirmed excerpts are CLAIMED_ONLY, required rather than merely permitted. WITHHELD means evidence legitimately unavailable; present, confirmed evidence recorded as WITHHELD would be the false-withholding error ruled against under BLP-004 Q1.
